blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Oriental Mindoro Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan has called for a review of the country’s rice liberalization policy, saying it has failed to protect Filipino farmers from falling palay prices while keeping rice affordable for consumers. In a privilege speech at the House of Representatives on November 23, Panaligan urged the government to reclaim a stronger role in regulating the rice industry, citing declining farm gate prices, high production costs, inadequate agricultural support, and the continued dependence on imported rice. He posted his speech on his social media page on Thursday. READ: A cure for the rice sector’s ills […]... Keep on reading: Oriental Mindoro solon urges review of rice liberalization policy
